recent_posts.title: GoDaddy uses Amazon QuickSight and Amazon Q to compress business intelligence analytics from weeks to minutes
recent_posts.summary: Business analysts at GoDaddy have significantly reduced the time required to generate business intelligence insights by using Amazon QuickSight and Amazon Q. This shift from manual dashboard creation to utilizing scalable and accessible tools allows analysts to deliver real-time insights more efficiently and focus on data analysis rather than dashboard maintenance.

recent_posts.title: How GoDaddy Auctions Fights Fraud to Increase Customer Trust
recent_posts.summary: GoDaddy Auctions has made significant strides in combating shill bidding to enhance customer trust and fairness in its online auction platform. Key measures include advanced fraud detection signals, identity verification for new and existing members, and a revamped user interface. The company's fraud prevention strategy focuses on membership purchase, account verification, and bid verification. Recent updates in 2024 have contributed to a noticeable reduction in fraudulent activities, ensuring a safer environment for genuine buyers.

recent_posts.title: Elevating Security Through Automated Secret Rotations: GoDaddy’s Innovative Approach
recent_posts.summary: GoDaddy enhances its security through innovative secret rotation practices that integrate automation with team collaboration. By rotating secrets more frequently and incorporating advanced automation strategies, GoDaddy reduces the window of vulnerability. Practices like the 'Periodic Team Ceremony' are central to their approach, combining manual efforts with plans for further automation. These strategies ensure resilience and proactive security, setting new industry standards.

recent_posts.title: Threat Actors Push ClickFix Fake Browser Updates Using Stolen Credentials
recent_posts.summary: GoDaddy Security Researchers have identified a surge in malware distribution through fake WordPress plugins. These plugins appear legitimate but inject JavaScript for fake browser update prompts, leveraging social engineering to compromise users. Threat actors use stolen admin credentials to install these plugins on websites, rather than exploiting WordPress vulnerabilities. The malware employs blockchain technology and smart contracts to deliver payloads. Over 25,000 sites have been detected with this variant since August 2023, with over 6,000 affected since June 2024. The threat continues to evolve, using multiple vectors and automated processes to evade detection.

recent_posts.title: Generative AI Domain Search
recent_posts.summary: GoDaddy has introduced an AI-powered domain search feature that uses Large Language Models (LLMs) like GPT to generate relevant and available domain names. The GenAI Domain Search enhances the user experience by understanding the context and intent of queries, providing personalized domain suggestions. The system leverages advanced technologies, including vector databases and an internal LLM, to ensure highly relevant and diverse domain name options. The AI component is integrated across GoDaddy's platform, facilitating a seamless search and purchasing process for customers.

recent_posts.title: From Text to Transformers: How LLMs Are Enhancing GoDaddy’s CMS Experience
recent_posts.summary: GoDaddy's internal hackathon explored the integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into their headless cloud CMS to enhance content creation and editing. The hackathon project developed by the Copy AIchemists team aimed to streamline content migration, automate alt text generation for images, optimize SEO fields, and facilitate text generation within the CMS. Their prototype won in the 'Data Overload' category and demonstrated significant improvements in workflow efficiency and content quality for content editors.

recent_posts.title: Four Lessons I’ve Learned Starting My Engineering Career at GoDaddy
recent_posts.summary: A software engineer shares four key lessons learned during the first two years at GoDaddy: envisioning a career as a marathon rather than a sprint, maintaining curiosity, viewing problem-solving as an enjoyable challenge, and prioritizing fundamental technologies over specific tools. Supportive team members and a flexible learning approach have been crucial in gaining these insights.

recent_posts.title: Elasticsearch as a Search Service
recent_posts.summary: Re:amaze is a tool by GoDaddy that helps businesses manage customer communications in a single inbox. The Re:amaze team adopted Elasticsearch as their new search service due to difficulties in managing the self-hosted search service. They faced problems with lengthy indexing time, lengthy recovery speeds, and high operating costs. They considered cloud-based Postgres as an alternative but chose cloud-based Elasticsearch for its fully-managed solution, support for search features, fine-grained control, search speed, and lower operational costs. The implementation process involved adopting the search features, handling the data volume, keeping the data in sync, incorporating selective ingestion, and making a smooth switchover. The switch to Elasticsearch resulted in uninterrupted search, lower latency, and significant cost savings.

recent_posts.title: Influencing Experimentation Culture via Platform Features
recent_posts.summary: GoDaddy discusses how they shaped their experimentation culture through improvements in their Hivemind platform, including categorizing scorecard metrics, requirements for new feature utilization, automated conclusivity, and platform badging.

recent_posts.title: How the GoDaddy data platform achieved over 60% cost reduction and 50% performance boost by adopting Amazon EMR Serverless
recent_posts.summary: Learn how the GoDaddy data platform achieved significant cost reduction and performance boost by adopting Amazon EMR Serverless on arm64, with benefits including faster Spark workloads, improved development and testing speed, and reduced carbon footprint.
